purpose.summary: ORCR0480 is a batch COBOL program that generates detailed receipt (claim) files for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system, specifically handling long-term/short-term care and self-pay receipts. It reads indexed patient and claim data files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE47, RECE471), processes and edits the data (including disease names, treatment periods, and billing amounts), and writes output receipt detail files along with error and date files.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) project used in Japanese medical clinics. Japanese comments are encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this excerpt. The program is large (3290 lines) and shows multiple years of maintenance history, consistent with production medical billing software.
